title: Harnessing pathogen stress-hormone sensing for living medicines
content:
by Weston R. Whitaker

Pathogens sense host stress hormones in the gut and use them to regulate motility and virulence. A new study in PLOS Biology transfers this pathway to Escherichia coli Nissle and redesigns its regulation to drive programmable outputs.
